headline: Storm Cleanup Continues Across the Region
text:
Storm Cleanup Continues Across the Region

A spokesperson for the department declined to comment on the specifics, saying only that a full report would be released soon. Teachers and parents have raised concerns about class sizes, and the district says it is reviewing staffing levels. A small group of volunteers spent the morning clearing debris from the trail after the storm. Residents packed the meeting room, many carrying signs and asking for more detail about how the money would be spent. For now, the practical effect is modest: a handful of new signs, a revised schedule and a promise to revisit the issue in the fall.
